Infer one-vs-rest rhythmic markers

Source: R/infer_ovr_rhythm.R
infer_ovr_rhythm.Rd

For each target group, all remaining cells are pooled as Rest. Target and Rest are fitted with infer_gene_param() using the same inputs.

Usage

infer_ovr_rhythm(
  count,
  metadata,
  theta_pred,
  r_cell,
  group_by,
  ZT_by,
  target_groups = NULL,
  q_cut = 0.05,
  amp_cut = 0.25,
  n_worker = NULL,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE,
  sample_by = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

count

Gene-by-cell raw count matrix.

metadata

Cell-level metadata aligned by the cell column.

theta_pred

Inferred cell phases in radians.

r_cell

Cell-level rhythmic reliability values between 0 and 1.

group_by

Metadata column containing the groups to compare.

ZT_by

Metadata column containing zeitgeber-time bins.

target_groups

Optional groups to test. By default, all groups are used.

q_cut

FDR threshold for target-specific rhythmic markers.

amp_cut

Minimum fitted target amplitude.

n_worker

Number of parallel workers passed to infer_gene_param().

setseed

Random seed.

Verbose

Logical; whether to print progress messages.

sample_by

Optional metadata column identifying independent biological samples for sample-aware inference.

...

Additional arguments passed to infer_gene_param(), such as B and sample_boot_by.

Value

A list containing ovr_result, ovr_markers, ovr_summary, the name of group_by, and analysis settings. The result table retains fitted Target and Rest Mesor, mean, amplitude, and phase values so that model-based curves can be drawn with plot_ovr_curve().
